notable_clients: BMW Manufacturing (pilot deployment at Spartanburg, South Carolina plant)
OpenAI (strategic collaboration for neural network training and AI model development)

facts.founders_experience: Figure AI was founded by Brett Adcock, who previously co-founded Vettery (acquired by Adecco Group) and Archer Aviation (NYSE: ACHR), a leading eVTOL aircraft company. The leadership team includes experts in robotics, AI, and autonomous systems, with backgrounds at companies like Boston Dynamics, Tesla, Google, and Apple. The team has deep experience in scaling hardware and software platforms for enterprise deployment.

key_leaders.name: Brett Adcock
key_leaders.title: Founder & CEO
key_leaders.background: Co-founder of Vettery (acquired by Adecco Group) and Archer Aviation (NYSE: ACHR). Expertise in scaling technology companies and hardware innovation.

key_leaders.name: Jerry Pratt
key_leaders.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
key_leaders.background: Former Senior Research Scientist at the Florida Institute for Human & Machine Cognition (IHMC), with over 20 years of experience in humanoid robotics and bipedal locomotion.

key_leaders.name: Damion Shelton
key_leaders.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
key_leaders.background: Co-founder and former CEO of Agility Robotics, with extensive experience in robotics hardware development and commercialization.

facts.deployment_scale: Figure AI has demonstrated pilot deployments in industrial settings, including a partnership with BMW Manufacturing for autonomous tasks in manufacturing. The company is actively testing and refining its humanoid robot, Figure 01, with plans for broader enterprise deployment in 2025.

use_cases: Autonomous humanoid robots for industrial and manufacturing tasks
AI-driven automation in logistics, warehousing, and supply chain operations

interfaces: Natural language interaction for human-robot collaboration
